column1: # listtoggle unit table (spec R4, acceptance A2): ONE ROW PER MEASURED CASE.
# The bytes are NOT copied here: tests/listtoggle.rs reads the fixture (before)
# and stock 1.13.7's after-bytes straight out of
# docs/recon-listtoggle/evidence/<case>.txt, and checks that the palette command
# this row names is the one the evidence recorded. A sel/caret dump in the
# evidence (stock typed "Z" over its selection after the command) is asserted
# by typing "Z" over OUR mapped selection; an undo dump must equal "before".
# selection = anchor-head as line.col (model coordinates). It is cross-checked
# against a replay of the case's recorded keystrokes; "keys=no" rows are the
# ones where the keys do not determine the model selection (Live Preview's
# Ctrl+Home lands BELOW the Properties widget, README q09-fmb; and a vertical
# move from column > 0, whose goal column is in PIXELS, README Q12 q12b-cliprep).
# Measured cases with NO row: q01-ids (command ids, no edit), q14-reading
# (reading view: command absent, no write — asserted by the gate/registry),
# q16-* (the checkbox command, not this op; filed as a todo, R6).
